translations./teaching/prediction_prompt: How will chassis, tires, motor, computer, and sensors change the result on the same proving route?
translations./teaching/knowledge_card: Manual input takes over immediately; click the ground to let the complete autonomy stack plan and drive. Multiple surfaces and 2.5D terrain come from map data.
translations./maneuvers/0/description: Accelerate from a fixed start and stop at the dry-pavement line.
translations./maneuvers/1/description: Repeat the same stop on the low-grip standing-water pad.
translations./maneuvers/2/description: Compare geometric and measured radius through the handling entry.
translations./maneuvers/3/description: Pass three offset barriers while observing steering tracking and slip.
translations./maneuvers/4/description: Drive from ramp foot to highland while measuring grade, speed, and slip.
translations./maneuvers/5/description: Cross the banked lane while observing roll, support, and rollover risk.
translations./maneuvers/6/description: Cross deterministic 25 mm relief while recording contact and body attitude.
translations./maneuvers/7/description: Rotate manually beside calibration targets to compare 1-line and 16-line returns.
